messages:
maria: quick thought: let's define a tiny loader-plugin ABI so runtime can accept mmap bundles, http-range streams, and on-the-fly gunzip without special-casing.
trevor: sounds good. what's the minimum handshake we need?
maria: three verbs: PROBE(metadata), OPEN(mode, descriptor), READ(offset,len,flags). PROBE returns tiny fields: uncompressed_size, bytes_per_shard, sha256, header_flags, optional index_snippet (base64).
jing: important: OPEN must be async-friendly. streaming backends should return a reader token and support async read-ahead. blocking reads will kill prefix-latency.
devin: ops/metrics item: emit shard_io_p50/p95, prefetch_bytes_inflight, fallback_count, and shard_commit_failures. add per-model tags.
maria: example probe payload: ```json
{"probe_path": "https://cdn.example.com/model/v2/weights.safetensors.gz", "expect_index": false}
```
trevor: if expect_index is false we can't random-access cheaply. plan for index_snippet on probe to map first N tensors -> offsets so prefix warmup works. fallback is linear scan which is bad for large shards.
jing: also need an admission token for warmup ops so we don't race with eviction/pinning. token should be local per-gpu with priority buckets.
devin: suggestion: token pool default 64 tokens per-gpu; prefetch limit 64MB. metrics-driven autoscaling of token pool later.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: rollout/loader-plugin-v1 -> canary at 2026-03-21T18:05:00Z :rocket:
maria: canary plan: route 1% traffic to streaming-mode loaders, max-prefetch=32MB, failover-to-mmap after 8s read stall or on checksum error. collect >1h of io/latency metrics before widening.
trevor: add a synchronous checksum verify before committing a shard to weight cache; if mismatch, try signed mirror URL. log debug_trace_id across probe/open/read for correlation.
jing: +1 on trace id. also add a light-mode that only probes index_snippet and doesn't prefetch data. useful for fast route sizing.
devin: action items: 1) formal ABI doc PR, 2) metrics & dashboards, 3) admission-token implementation + knobs, 4) canary runbook + rollback thresholds.
maria: i'll open the ABI PR and a short runbook draft. pinging @trevor @jing for reviews. thanks :pray:
